issues.title: Interactive features need UV
issues.detail: Utah R392-302-41 requires a secondary disinfection system on an interactive water feature.
issues.fix_hint: Turn on UV in Treatment, or apply the Chlorine, UV and sand filter preset.

issues.title: Suction velocity 6.2 ft/s is over 6.0 ft/s
issues.detail: Interactive suction is held to 6 ft/s at the real operating flow (160 gpm).

issues.title: Turnover is 28 minutes against the 30-minute rule

verdict.headline: Not buildable yet: one code blocker.

lines.label: Power (3.7 kW, 10 h a day, May to September)

steps: Shut off and disconnect the autofill
Lower the water below the returns and skimmers, or drain the basin
Drain pump p1: open the drain plugs, store them in the basket
Drain the filter, heater and strainers; open every equipment drain
Pull the upward-facing nozzles and fit winter caps
Turn off and lock out the feature circuits; leave heat on in a heated room

startup: Balance chlorine and pH; record the first test.
Run every zone and check the jet heights.
